content:
maya: alert: Grafana alert 'egress-packet-loss eu-west-2b' fired at 12:03 UTC. Several gpu-pool pods in eu-west-2b showing IO stalls and pod attach errors. Latency +5x, increased retry counts.

sre-oncall: saw it. pods in pool-gpu-euwest2b are failing readiness probes intermittently. Notified infra. Starting triage.

jordan: digging into k8s events now. I see kubelet reports 'network plugin: failed to set up sandbox' and 'attach/detach timeout' on 3 nodes.

kevin: looks like egress NAT gateway throttling? Cloud provider metrics show high SNAT connection count in 2b and >95% conn table usage. Might be a transient surge from spot reclaims + eval job fanout.

maya: Plan: soft-cordon eu-west-2b GPU nodes, drain non-critical tenants (batch jobs, internal evals). Hold back live webhooks and high-SLA tenants until we confirm stable path. Anyone object?

rachel: agree. Also we should enable fallbacks: route model requests from 2b to eu-west-2a with weight 0.85 and keep 0.15 local for cleanup and cache flush.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: cordon applied to nodes: gpu-eu2b-03, gpu-eu2b-07, gpu-eu2b-11.

jordan: running drain command now: ```kubectl drain gpu-eu2b-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120``` starting migration of cached KV. ETA ~6m per node.

kevin: watch cost — shifting traffic into eu-west-2a is already triggering spot surge there. We have a transient +12% spot price and a couple of preemptions reported. If that continues, we'll see more attach failures.

maya: can we instead spin temporary dedicated instances to absorb the surge? We have a small reserved pool (reserved-dyn-queue-1) we can spin up in 2a for 30–60m.

rachel: +1, I'll trigger scaleUp. Command: ```terraform apply -var='pool=reserved-dyn-queue-1' -auto-approve```

billing-bot: notice: expected short term cost increase ~$1.2k/hr if reserved-dyn-queue-1 used. Reply with APPROVE to proceed.

kevin: APPROVE — cost of degraded SLAs is higher than a short reserved bump. Also recommend enabling model-quantized fallback for tenants with low-quality tolerance to reduce memory pressure: see /cfg/model-fallbacks/*.json.

maya: Jordan, once drains finish, ensure prefix/KV cache warming in 2a before shifting majority of traffic. Use replay of last 30m requests into cache-warm pipeline (non-prod replay mode).

jordan: started cache warm replay job: job-id cw-1765432100-1. Streaming logs: 'warmed 23/120 model prefixes' — will keep it running until 80% warmed.

sre-oncall: we've started routing 60% of traffic to 2a via the routing service. Command run: ```curl -s -X POST https://routing.internal/weights -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"from":"eu-west-2b","to":"eu-west-2a","weight":0.6}'```

ops-bot: audit: routing weight change recorded by deploy-bot at 12:18 UTC.

rachel: monitoring: tailing model-latency and batch success rate. Latency normalized after warmup; batch success increased. Spot preemptions in 2a decreased after reserved spin-up.

maya: post-incident actions (initial): - review SNAT scaling thresholds and conntrack alerting; - add automated soft-cordon policy when attach errors >3/min; - document tenant prioritization & eviction order for partial AZ drains; - run a dry-run of drain and warmup in staging. Assign owners?

kevin: I'll own SNAT threshold review and cloud provider coordination.
rachel: I'll own the automated cordon policy and alert updates.
jordan: I'll document the migration playbook and cache-warm runbook (include commands and estimated timings).

maya: thanks team. We'll keep this thread open until all nodes are back healthy and traffic fully reconciled. On-call handoff in 30m. :thumbsup:
